name: Fast-Casual Commerce Page Blueprints
instructions: Choose only the blueprints required by the verified business model. Remove unsupported fulfilment, payment, loyalty, tracking, or promotion features rather than inventing them.

blueprints.purpose: Establish branch and fulfilment context, surface high-priority products or deals, and move the customer into the menu quickly.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Compact commerce header followed by context selection and an immediate product or category entry point. Keep marketing secondary.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Prioritise branch, fulfilment, menu entry, and cart. Use a bottom cart action only when it does not cover content or system controls.
antiPatterns: full-screen marketing hero before menu access
branch or fulfilment hidden until checkout
acceptanceCriteria: A first-time customer can identify the active branch or address context.
The primary menu or order action is available in the first viewport.
Store-closed and delivery-unavailable states have safe alternatives.

blueprints.purpose: Help customers browse available products by category, understand price and key attributes, and add or customise items.
requiredBlocks: search when catalog size justifies it
blueprints.desktopComposition: Category rail and product grid with visible prices and stable card heights. Cart may use a side summary when space permits.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Use horizontally scrollable category navigation with visible selected state; use one- or two-column cards based on content and image quality; keep product actions reachable without hover.
antiPatterns: category navigation that loses selected context
disabled-looking cards with no availability explanation
acceptanceCriteria: Each purchasable product exposes a clear price and action.
Unavailable products cannot be added.
Changing category preserves branch, fulfilment, and cart context.

blueprints.purpose: Help customers complete required choices, optional modifiers, removals, quantity, and price review before adding a product.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Two-region layout with stable product context and scrollable configuration. Keep the total and primary action visible without obscuring options.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Use a full-screen route or sheet with a persistent, safe-area-aware action bar. Required groups must remain reachable after validation.
antiPatterns: modal too small for product options
required options indicated only by colour
add action enabled while required choices are missing
acceptanceCriteria: Required groups are programmatically identified and keyboard operable.
The displayed total matches the selected options and quantity.
A validation error moves focus to the first unresolved group without clearing other choices.

blueprints.purpose: Let customers review configured items, quantities, discounts, fees, fulfilment, conflicts, and the next checkout action.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Line items and order summary in separate but connected regions. Keep material price changes close to affected items.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Use a full cart page or full-height drawer. Keep the total and next action visible after the user has reviewed conflicts and changes.
antiPatterns: hidden fees revealed only after payment selection
remove action without accessible confirmation or undo
acceptanceCriteria: All line items can be edited or removed with keyboard and touch.
Material cart changes are explicit.
Checkout is blocked while unresolved conflicts remain.

blueprints.purpose: Collect and validate customer, fulfilment, address, schedule, payment, consent, and final order confirmation information.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Single-column staged form or two-column form and sticky summary. Avoid splitting related address and fulfilment information.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Use sequential sections with a concise summary and safe-area-aware final action. Do not hide validation behind a collapsed section.
antiPatterns: guest checkout blocked without a business requirement
payment success treated as order confirmation without an order identifier
unexpected cart reset on payment failure
acceptanceCriteria: Submission is idempotent.
Errors preserve valid customer and cart data.
The customer sees the final total and fulfilment context before placing the order.

blueprints.purpose: Confirm that the business accepted the order and provide the information needed for fulfilment, support, receipt, and tracking.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Clear confirmation panel followed by order details and next steps.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Place status, identifier, next step, and support above secondary detail.
acceptanceCriteria: The customer can prove and locate the order.
The next fulfilment action is clear.
Support is reachable without restarting the order.

blueprints.purpose: Show verified order progress, fulfilment details, support, and terminal outcomes without inventing precision.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Status-led page with detail and support secondary.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Current status and next action first; timeline remains readable without horizontal scrolling.
antiPatterns: animated progress unrelated to backend status
map treated as the only status explanation
acceptanceCriteria: Status is derived from verified order data.
Every terminal or exceptional state has a support path.
Reduced-motion users receive the same status information.

blueprints.purpose: Explain available, verified promotions and let eligible customers apply them without obscuring conditions.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Prioritised deal list with conditions available before action.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: One primary deal per card or row; conditions expand without moving the action out of context.
antiPatterns: deal price without normal-price context when legally or commercially required
promotion applied without showing cart impact
acceptanceCriteria: Customers can understand qualification before changing the cart.
Expired or ineligible promotions cannot be applied.
The cart shows the exact discount effect.

blueprints.purpose: Explain earning and redemption, show verified balance and activity, and support safe reward use.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Balance and primary rule first, followed by redemption and activity.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Keep balance, eligible value, and redemption consequence visible before confirmation.
antiPatterns: points treated as cash without explaining conversion
balance displayed when stale without a status indication
acceptanceCriteria: Balance and redemption are sourced from the loyalty system.
Applying a reward updates the order summary explicitly.
Customers can understand expiry and eligibility.

blueprints.purpose: Help customers find an eligible branch by location, hours, service mode, and current availability.
blueprints.desktopComposition: Search and list remain primary; map is supportive rather than mandatory.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: List-first result with optional map view. Selection must not depend on hover or tiny map targets.
antiPatterns: distance guessed from straight-line coordinates without disclosure
acceptanceCriteria: Branch selection works without granting geolocation.
Closed and unsupported-service branches are clear.
Selected branch propagates to menu, cart, and checkout.

blueprints.purpose: Validate an address against current delivery service, branch eligibility, fees, minimums, and scheduling rules.
requiredBlocks: verified fee and minimum when known
blueprints.desktopComposition: Address input with immediate status and branch context.
blueprints.mobileTransformation: Use native-friendly address entry, clear progress, and a full-width result; keep pickup alternative visible.
antiPatterns: accepting an address before service validation
delivery promise based on incomplete address
zone failure with no pickup or branch alternative
map pin as the only accessible input
acceptanceCriteria: Delivery eligibility is verified before checkout.
Ineligible customers receive truthful alternatives.
Changing the address triggers cart and price revalidation.
